verdict.rationale: Kick provides AI-generated categorization (97% auto-categorized), real-time P&L updates, AI-driven MCP tools to query transactions/generate reports/suggest bookkeeping changes, and AI integration via Google Sheets (Gemini/Claude/ChatGPT) for trend summarization and forecasting — all inside the product's data surfaces. This directly delivers AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's financial data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality beyond vendor docs, and no evidence of proactive/unprompted insight generation (e.g., anomaly alerts) beyond categorization and on-demand querying.
